decision: Owner accepted v2 navs and selected fully unwrapped stock pods; replacement geometry rejected

navMaterials.ns:
material crnvns : CR_BZBase
{
    set_texture_alias DiffuseMap crnvns_d.dds
    set_texture_alias NormalMap flat_N.dds
    set_texture_alias SpecularMap crvcca_patch_s.dds
    set_texture_alias EmissiveMap crnvns_e.dds
    set $diffuse "1 1 1"
    set $ambient "1 1 1"
    set $specular ".25 .25 .25"
    set $shininess "48"
}
